visual.general_description: Four-panel figure of axial chest CT slices, panels A to D, each with a printed title and a white arrow: A and B in a lung window showing micronodules, C and D in a soft-tissue window showing hilar and mediastinal adenomegaly with necrotic centre.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 grid of grayscale axial chest CT slices on black backgrounds, each under a white caption cell with a printed panel letter and title. Top row, lung windows: A "Axial MIP: Bronchiolar distribution of micronodules, sparing the pleural border" and B "Axial standard: Right upper lobar micronodules". Bottom row, soft-tissue windows with enhancing vessels: C "Right hilar adenomegaly with necrotic centre" and D "Adenomegaly of Barety's lodge with necrotic centre". Each panel has a single white arrow drawn on the slice. No patient name, date, scanner text or scale is printed on any panel.

panels.general_description: Axial chest CT in a lung window with a printed title naming a maximum intensity projection of bronchiolar-distribution micronodules sparing the pleural border; a white arrow points into the lung.
panels.detailed_description: Axial grayscale chest CT slice on a black background in a lung window. Printed title text above the image reads "A. Axial MIP: Bronchiolar distribution of micronodules, sparing the pleural border". A white arrow starts at the left of the image and points toward the lung on the left side of the image. Fine branching bright vessel and bronchovascular markings fill both lungs, with small punctate densities scattered along them; the heart and mediastinum are seen centrally.
